title: Chapter 315 Ye Tian Is Out
content:
Chapter 315 Ye Tian Is Out

A protector?

Lu Daosheng pondered slightly, and the phantom in front of him naturally could not see the relationship between him and Lu Xue.

He doesn't have the strength either.

Unless Lu Daosheng is willing.

"I'm just passing by."

In the end, Lu Daosheng chose to hide it.

He was afraid that the guy in front of him would open the back door for his daughter, so wouldn't he come in vain?

Although this guy is just an ant in front of him, in the eyes of these juniors, in the eyes of the fairy world, he is almost the supreme existence.

He is fine usually, but he just likes to upgrade occasionally.

Now, he doesn't know what level he is.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's answer, the phantom in front of him was obviously a little disappointed.

"That's how it is."

Seeing the phantom feeling a little lost, Lu Daosheng said, "Do you want to find someone to inherit your palace?"

Hearing this, the phantom did not hide it and nodded slightly.

"This inheritance has been buried here, it's a pity."

As he said that, the phantom turned his head to look at a place in the palace, and the scene of Lu Xue and others suddenly appeared in front of the two of them.

"One of these people is a man of destiny who has great luck and is the most suitable person to inherit this inheritance."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng naturally knew that the guy in front of him was referring to his daughter.

"Then why don't you pass on this inheritance to her directly?"

The phantom shook his head slightly.

"That little girl looks stupid and stupid. I don't know how she became a destined person. I even have some doubts that God is blind."

"If my inheritance is handed over to her, it is likely to be buried."

"I don't dare to gamble."

The phantom sighed, his words full of helplessness.

At this moment, he did not notice that Lu Daosheng's expression was very bad, and his eyes looked at him were even a little angry.

Say this to my daughter in front of me?

Taking a deep breath, Lu Daosheng forced his anger to suppress his heart, and then smiled and said without a smile: "She can be a person of destiny, so it is of course her reason. Perhaps, she can really pass on your inheritance. Promote it."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng was suddenly a little incredible.

Didn’t I come to exercise for my daughter? Why did I help?

When he heard Lu Daosheng's words, the phantom was stunned and silent for a long time, saying, "Well, it makes sense. I don't know how long my will can last. If I miss this opportunity, I might meet again. Not here."

"Let's do this. If this little girl can live to the end, I will hand over my inheritance to her."

It seemed that he had made some major decision, but the phantom was actually a little transparent.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng's expression remained unchanged, but he knew it in his heart.

It should be that he awakened the ancient battlefield before and also awakened him.

Otherwise, this bronze palace would probably be buried here for the rest of its life.

And the phantom's requirements for Lu Xue were also placed at a very low level.

Just be alive.

Well, let’s see how much my daughter can do.

Inside the bronze palace.

Several forces met and fought together without any surprise.

Faced with the joining forces between Ye Tian and Chu Xingyue, Tang Hao and Ye Wuwei also chose to join forces.

Otherwise, they will only be eliminated one by one.

"Tang Hao, I miss you as a member of Tiandi Academy. My ancient family has always had good friends with you Tiandi Academy. Now that I have left, I will not blame you."

Looking at Tang Hao in the distance, Chu Xingyue said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, Tang Hao sneered, "It's all over the place. Do you really think that the ancient battlefield is the back garden of your ancient family. The current ancient battlefield has long been exposed to the eyes of the world in the fairyland. Next, enter the ancient battlefield. There will only be more and more people."

As soon as these words came out, not only Ye Tian and Chu Xingyue, but even Ye Wuwei was shocked.

"What!"

Ye Tian's face looked ugly.

He couldn't figure out why this happened.

"Damn it, which bastard did it?!"

At this time, Ye Tian was obviously blinded by anger.

Chu Xingyue, who was beside her, frowned slightly.

She couldn't understand why Ye Tian's IQ was so low, so she wouldn't say whether this kind of thing was caused by humans.

Even if it is, how terrifying a person who can do this is.

If you insult the other person like this, you will not be killed.

Sure enough, just as Ye Tian finished speaking, a terrifying energy suddenly surged out of the bronze mural beside him without warning.

boom!

With a loud bang.

Ye Tian was directly bombarded.

"Ye Tian!"

Seeing this scene, Chu Xingyue was shocked.

She was not worried about Ye Tian, but about herself. If something happened to Ye Tian, she would definitely not be able to deal with Ye Wuwei and Tang Hao.

Obviously, the combat power of several people is almost not much different.

Unless you use the trump card regardless of consequences.

Otherwise, it will be extremely difficult to decide the outcome.

In the distance, Tang Hao and Ye Wuwei looked overjoyed when they saw this scene.

"Hahaha, Ye Tian, you've been punished."

At this time, Ye Wuwei almost couldn't stop smiling. Seeing Ye Tian's life and death unknown, he only felt relieved.

At this time, Chu Xingyue hurried to Ye Tian.

Seeing Ye Tian fainted, Chu Xingyue's pretty face was pale.

The changes in this ancient battlefield were really caused by humans!

So what exactly exists? !

In the distance, a group of at a loss were watching.

Faced with the battle of monsters at the level of Tang Hao, they couldn't even intervene.

The only thing that can be done is to pick up the bargain.

But even so, no one left the Bronze Palace.

What if you really find something?

Everyone has a sense of luck in their hearts.

Lu Xue and others also saw the scene of Tang Hao and others fighting.

When Lu Xue was angry when she heard Ye Tian insulting Lu Daosheng, she almost couldn't help but lift her sword and slash it up.

The same is true for Ao Qing and Qin Feng and Xiao Luo.

Fortunately, the retribution comes very quickly.

Ye Tian was eliminated early because he was unknown.

"Chu Xingyue, Ye Tian is no longer able to do it now. If you are tactful, you should leave by yourself. I don't want to do it."

As he said this, Ye Wuwei was ready to rub Chu Xingyue.

Tang Hao sighed and said, "Miss Chu, you are right. My Tiandi Academy has always had good friends with your ancient family. If you quit voluntarily, I can leave it alone."

Tang Hao returned the original words just now to Chu Xingyue directly.

This made Chu Xingyue look ugly.

After a moment of silence, Chu Xingyue crushed a note to transmit.

Not long after, someone will come to pick Ye Tian up.

After all, the ancient battlefield can be regarded as the home court of their ancient family.

It is still possible to let Ye Tian leave safely.

And she couldn't watch Ye Tian wait to die here, even though she was not happy with Ye Tian.

"If I try my best, although I can't beat you and the other two, I can still hurt you and the other two."

Chu Xingyue looked at the two of them and said in a straight voice.

Upon hearing this, both of them frowned slightly.

Chu Xingyue said it is true.

It depends on whether they are willing to pay a price.

After a moment of silence, Tang Hao took a few steps back first.

"Tang Hao, you!"

Ye Wuwei couldn't believe that Tang Hao was so cowardly.

Tang Hao spread his hands, "I forgot to tell you that Chen Mingyu is here, and I guess he has entered a deeper place. If we still hesitate here, I'm afraid that the good things will be taken by that kid."

"Chen Mingyu!"

Chu Xingyue and Ye Wuwei were shocked.

There is actually someone here who has taken the lead.

And it is Chen Mingyu, whose strength is not much different from theirs.

Thinking of this, the three of them stopped fighting and quickly retreated aside to start recovering.
